channel.title: TeamTango Changelog
channel.description: What we've shipped in TeamTango, the team engagement platform.

item.title: Fixes across time off, Insights and profiles
item.description: Time off that spans two months now shows in both on the team calendar, and time-off dates load reliably on the calendar and request lists. Insights ranks Top Contributors by the same engagement score shown next to each person, and "Challenge" is now the one name for challenge posts everywhere. Profiles show department and location separately, each with its own icon. On phones, the post composer's toolbar fits the screen and event attendee avatars no longer cut off each other's initials.

item.title: Gift funds stay a surprise
item.description: A gift fund is now invisible to the person it's for, wherever it would otherwise show up. Their own birthday is also left out of the upcoming-birthdays lists they see, so gift planning stays a secret.

item.title: Mattermost channels
item.description: Mattermost joins Slack and Microsoft Teams as a chat destination: pick a channel and the events to send, and TeamTango posts them there.

item.title: Your workspace is ready the moment you sign up
item.description: Signing up now creates your workspace straight away. Setup is two short steps — name it, invite your team — and people you invite join your workspace instead of getting one of their own.

item.title: Automations
item.description: TeamTango can now post birthdays, work anniversaries, and new joiners to the wall on its own, and send a weekly digest email. Each automation is off until an admin switches it on.

item.title: Slack, Microsoft Teams, and webhooks
item.description: Send new posts, kudos, celebrations, time-off updates, events, and new joiners to a Slack or Microsoft Teams channel — or to any service through signed webhooks with automatic retries.

item.title: Notifications
item.description: A notification bell that updates live, emails for the things that need your attention, and preferences so everyone chooses what reaches their inbox.

item.title: Real-time feed
item.description: New posts, reactions, comments, and pins appear for everyone the moment they happen — no refresh needed.

item.title: AI post categorization
item.description: Write your post and TeamTango suggests whether it's a highlight, kudos, or challenge. You can always change the suggestion before posting.

item.title: Team calendar and company holidays
item.description: A wallchart of who's off, person by person and day by day. Teams spread across countries see each person's own public holidays, and admins can add company-wide days off.

item.title: Run gift funds end to end
item.description: Create and close gift funds right from the dashboard widget, not just contribute to them.

item.title: Profiles, avatars, and in-app help
item.description: Everyone gets a profile page with an uploadable avatar, @mentions link to it, and a new Help page covers getting started, common questions, and keyboard shortcuts.

item.title: Team Pulse runs on live data
item.description: The dashboard stat cards — kudos sent, posts created, engagements, participation rate — now compute from your team's real activity, with week-over-week trends.

item.title: Events page
item.description: Create team events, RSVP with one tap, and see what's upcoming, happening right now, or already wrapped — complete with attendee lists and live status.

item.title: Anonymous pulse check-ins
item.description: Short, rotating check-in questions on how the team is doing, answered right from the wall. Results stay anonymous: no breakdown is shown until at least three people have answered.

item.title: Comments, plus events and gift funds on the dashboard
item.description: Every wall post now supports threaded comments. The dashboard gained an Upcoming Events widget and a Gift Fund widget with inline contributions.

item.title: Time-off overhaul
item.description: Working-day-aware request calculations, public holidays for 250+ countries with regional support, per-person work schedules and country overrides, half-day requests, and annual leave allowances with live balances.

item.title: People section, rebuilt
item.description: A single searchable directory with multi-select filters for department, team, role, and status — plus bulk actions and inline invitation management.

item.title: New design system
item.description: A cleaner, calmer TeamTango: refreshed typography, softer color palette, redesigned dashboard, stat cards with inline charts, and a reworked reactions row.

item.title: Post editing and celebrations
item.description: Edit or delete your posts after publishing, and a new Celebrate post type with birthday tracking for teammates.

item.title: Workspace invitations and onboarding
item.description: Invite teammates by email and walk new workspaces through a guided setup: departments, teams, and people in minutes.

item.title: Time-off requests
item.description: The first version of time off: request leave, get it approved, and see your team's availability.

item.title: Waitlist opens
item.description: TeamTango development kicks off in earnest and the waitlist goes live at teamtango.io.
